title: underline — vitally

sentences.sentence: This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
sentences.translation: 这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

phrases.translation: 生存价值；生存值；存活值

sentences.sentence: The doctors gave him a one in ten chance of survival .
sentences.translation: 医生说他有十分之一的生存希望。

sentences.sentence: A lot of small companies are having to fight for survival (= work hard in order to continue to exist ) .
sentences.translation: 很多小公司不得不挣扎求生。

sentences.sentence: dishonest traders
sentences.translation: 奸商

sentences.sentence: People on welfare are wrongly seen as lazy or dishonest.
sentences.translation: 靠福利救济的人被误以为懒惰或不老实。

phrases.translation: 玩忽职守；[法]失职；过失责任

sentences.sentence: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
sentences.translation: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

sentences.sentence: a neglected garden
sentences.translation: 疏于打理的花园

sentences.sentence: The building has been badly neglected.
sentences.translation: 这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

phrases.translation: n. 无主珍宝，无主埋藏物

sentences.sentence: Jim treasured the gold pocket watch that his grandfather had given him.
sentences.translation: 吉姆十分珍爱祖父送给他的金怀表。

sentences.sentence: a rigorous analysis of defence needs
sentences.translation: 对国防需求的缜密分析

sentences.sentence: the rigorous standards required by the college
sentences.translation: 大学规定的严格标准

sentences.sentence: If the answer is no, you really need to get some professional counseling to determine if this marriage should be saved.
sentences.translation: 如果回答是否定的，你就真的该去咨询一下专家，决定一下你是否改维持这段婚姻了。

sentences.sentence: In this study, the participants who took advantage of group and individual counseling offered as part of the diets had far greater success than those who chose to go it alone.
sentences.translation: 在这个研究中，充分利用作为饮食原则一部分的团队和个人咨询的参与者你那些选择自己进行的参与者得到了更大的成效。

sentences.sentence: Despite counseling and written advice about how to maintain their new weights, they gained an average of 12 pounds back over the next year.
sentences.translation: 尽管有如何保持研究者各自重获得的新体重方面的咨询与书面建议，但在过去一年里平均每人仍增重12磅左右。

sentences.sentence: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
sentences.translation: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

phrases.translation: n. 神曲（意大利诗人但丁作的叙事诗）

sentences.sentence: divine power
sentences.translation: 神的力量

sentences.sentence: divine love
sentences.translation: 上帝的慈爱

sentences.sentence: The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
sentences.translation: 该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

sentences.sentence: This has caused us to reassess the way we approach our planning.
sentences.translation: 这件事让我们重新审视了我们的规划方式。

sentences.sentence: a rude remark
sentences.translation: 粗鲁的话

sentences.sentence: I didn’t mean to be rude, but I had to leave early.
sentences.translation: 我并不想显得无礼，但我不得不早走。

phrases.translation: [美国口语]勇敢地承受；坚持到底
非常坚强的人；不易动感情的人；自信者
大胆果断的人；暴躁的人
严厉的爱（指为起到帮助作用而严厉地对待有问题的人）

sentences.sentence: It was a tough race.
sentences.translation: 比赛打得很艰难。

sentences.sentence: She’s had a tough life.
sentences.translation: 她的生活十分艰辛。

sentences.sentence: The company admitted that it had been a tough year.
sentences.translation: 公司承认那是艰难的一年。

sentences.sentence: Tough decisions will have to be made.
sentences.translation: 必须作出艰难的决定。

sentences.sentence: The reporters were asking a lot of tough questions .
sentences.translation: 记者们问了很多难以回答的问题。

sentences.sentence: (= a difficult decision ) , but we had to cancel the game because of the weather.
sentences.translation: 尽管是一个艰难的决定，但由于天气不好我们只得取消比赛。

sentences.sentence: I find his books pretty tough going (= difficult to read ) .
sentences.translation: 我发现他的书很难读。

sentences.sentence: Gage predicted the president’s proposal would be a tough sell (= something that is difficult to persuade someone about ) before Congress.
sentences.translation: 盖奇预言总统的提议在国会很难通过。

sentences.sentence: Ministers must appear before Parliament and justify their actions.
sentences.translation: 大臣们必须就自己的行为向议会作出解释。

phrases.translation: 持续性植物状态；植物状态

sentences.sentence: persistent rumours
sentences.translation: 持续流传的谣言

sentences.sentence: persistent headaches
sentences.translation: 持续头疼

sentences.sentence: a persistent problem
sentences.translation: 长期问题

sentences.sentence: persistent rain
sentences.translation: 连绵的雨

sentences.sentence: He had surpassed all our expectations .
sentences.translation: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

sentences.sentence: The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
sentences.translation: 多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

phrases.translation: 囚徒困境，囚徒困境悖论
道德上的左右为难；道德两难处境；伦理两难

sentences.sentence: a moral dilemma
sentences.translation: 道德上进退两难的窘境

sentences.sentence: This placed Robert Kennedy in a dilemma.
sentences.translation: 这让罗伯特·肯尼迪陷入了两难的境地。

sentences.sentence: Many women are faced with the dilemma of choosing between work and family commitments.
sentences.translation: 许多女性面临着出去工作还是照顾家庭的两难境地。

sentences.sentence: a useful technique for generating new ideas
sentences.translation: 能产生新创意的有用技术

sentences.sentence: The program would generate a lot of new jobs.
sentences.translation: 这个项目将创造许多新的就业岗位。

phrases.translation: 主因子，准素因子；一次因素
一次能源；最初的电子能量
初级治疗，初级护理；基层医疗
初级市场；初次市场（即证券发行机构）

sentences.sentence: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
sentences.translation: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

sentences.sentence: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
sentences.translation: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

sentences.sentence: Personal safety is of primary importance .
sentences.translation: 人身安全至关重要。

sentences.sentence: A sensible diet is vitally important if you want to remain in good health.
sentences.translation: 如想保持健康，合理的饮食十分重要。

text:
英语词汇 · 四级 · 第 45 单元

underline
音标：英 /ˌʌndəˈlaɪn/  美 /'ʌndəlaɪn/
v. 强调
例句：This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

survival
音标：英 /səˈvaɪvl/  美 /sɚ'vaɪvl/
n. 幸存
短语：survival rate — 存活率
短语：survival time — 生存时间；存活期
短语：survival of the fittest — 适者生存
短语：not only about survival — 不仅仅是为了生存
短语：survival condition — 生存状态；生存条件
短语：survival analysis — [医学]生存分析；存活分析
短语：survival ratio — 成活率；存活比
短语：survival probability — 存活率，残存几率
短语：survival value — 生存价值；生存值；存活值
短语：survival curve — 存活曲线
短语：field survival training — 野外生存训练
例句：The doctors gave him a one in ten chance of survival .
医生说他有十分之一的生存希望。
例句：A lot of small companies are having to fight for survival (= work hard in order to continue to exist ) .
很多小公司不得不挣扎求生。

dishonest
音标：英 /dɪsˈɒnɪst/  美 /dɪs'ɑnɪst/
adj. 不诚实的
例句：dishonest traders
奸商
例句：People on welfare are wrongly seen as lazy or dishonest.
靠福利救济的人被误以为懒惰或不老实。

neglect
音标：英 /nɪˈglekt/  美 /nɪ'glɛkt/
v. 忽视
短语：neglect of — 疏忽
短语：neglect of duty — 玩忽职守；[法]失职；过失责任
例句：She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。
例句：a neglected garden
疏于打理的花园
例句：The building has been badly neglected.
这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

treasure
音标：英 /ˈtreʒə(r)/  美 /'trɛʒɚ/
v. 珍爱
短语：treasure house — n. 宝库；宝藏室
短语：priceless treasure — 无价之宝
短语：treasure trove — n. 无主珍宝，无主埋藏物
短语：buried treasure — 宝藏；埋葬的宝藏；藏宝
短语：treasure chest — 财宝箱；宝库
短语：treasure map — 藏宝图
短语：treasure hunt — 寻宝游戏；寻找珍宝
短语：treasure up — 铭记，珍藏
短语：treasure hunter — 炸弹矿工；寻宝猎人
例句：Jim treasured the gold pocket watch that his grandfather had given him.
吉姆十分珍爱祖父送给他的金怀表。

rigorous
音标：英 /ˈrɪgərəs/  美 /'rɪɡərəs/
adj. 严格的
例句：a rigorous analysis of defence needs
对国防需求的缜密分析
例句：the rigorous standards required by the college
大学规定的严格标准

counseling
音标：英 /'kaʊnsəlɪŋ/  美 /'kaʊnslɪŋ/
n. 咨询服务
短语：psychological counseling — 心理咨询；心理辅导
短语：group counseling — 团体咨询；团体咨商
短语：career counseling — 职业咨询，事业咨询
短语：genetic counseling — 遗传咨询，基因咨询
例句：If the answer is no, you really need to get some professional counseling to determine if this marriage should be saved.
如果回答是否定的，你就真的该去咨询一下专家，决定一下你是否改维持这段婚姻了。
例句：In this study, the participants who took advantage of group and individual counseling offered as part of the diets had far greater success than those who chose to go it alone.
在这个研究中，充分利用作为饮食原则一部分的团队和个人咨询的参与者你那些选择自己进行的参与者得到了更大的成效。
例句：Despite counseling and written advice about how to maintain their new weights, they gained an average of 12 pounds back over the next year.
尽管有如何保持研究者各自重获得的新体重方面的咨询与书面建议，但在过去一年里平均每人仍增重12磅左右。

competent
音标：英 /ˈkɒmpɪtənt/  美 /'kɑmpɪtənt/
adj. 胜任的，有能力的
短语：competent authority — [法]主管当局，主管部门
短语：competent department — 主管部门
短语：competent in — 胜任的；有能力
短语：be competent for — 胜任
短语：competent jurisdiction — 合法的管辖权
短语：competent person — 称职人员；安全检察员
短语：competent court — 管辖法院；主管法庭
例句：A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

divine
音标：英 /dɪˈvaɪn/  美 /dɪ'vaɪn/
adj. 神圣的
短语：divine comedy — n. 神曲（意大利诗人但丁作的叙事诗）
短语：divine law — 神法
短语：divine service — 祭礼；礼拜
例句：divine power
神的力量
例句：divine love
上帝的慈爱

assess
音标：英 /əˈses/  美 /ə'sɛs/
v. 评价
例句：The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

reassess
音标：英 /ˌri:əˈses/  美 /'riə'sɛs/
v. 重新评估
例句：This has caused us to reassess the way we approach our planning.
这件事让我们重新审视了我们的规划方式。

rude
音标：英 /ru:d/  美 /rud/
adj. 粗鲁的
例句：a rude remark
粗鲁的话
例句：I didn’t mean to be rude, but I had to leave early.
我并不想显得无礼，但我不得不早走。

tough
音标：英 /tʌf/  美 /tʌf/
adj. 困难的
短语：tough guy — [美口]硬汉
短语：tough it out — [美国口语]勇敢地承受；坚持到底
短语：get tough with — [口语]对…强硬起来
短语：tough cookie — 非常坚强的人；不易动感情的人；自信者
短语：tough luck — 坏运气；真不走运
短语：tough nut — 大胆果断的人；暴躁的人
短语：tough love — 严厉的爱（指为起到帮助作用而严厉地对待有问题的人）
短语：hang tough — 坚持到底，顽强不屈
例句：It was a tough race.
比赛打得很艰难。
例句：She’s had a tough life.
她的生活十分艰辛。
例句：The company admitted that it had been a tough year.
公司承认那是艰难的一年。
例句：Tough decisions will have to be made.
必须作出艰难的决定。
例句：The reporters were asking a lot of tough questions .
记者们问了很多难以回答的问题。
例句：(= a difficult decision ) , but we had to cancel the game because of the weather.
尽管是一个艰难的决定，但由于天气不好我们只得取消比赛。
例句：I find his books pretty tough going (= difficult to read ) .
我发现他的书很难读。
例句：Gage predicted the president’s proposal would be a tough sell (= something that is difficult to persuade someone about ) before Congress.
盖奇预言总统的提议在国会很难通过。

justify
音标：英 /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/  美 /'dʒʌstə'fai/
v. 证明……正当
例句：Ministers must appear before Parliament and justify their actions.
大臣们必须就自己的行为向议会作出解释。

persistent
音标：英 /pəˈsɪstənt/  美 /pə'zɪstənt/
adj. 持续的，坚持的
短语：persistent organic pollutants — 持久性有机污染物
短语：persistent data — 不变数据；持久性数据
短语：persistent infection — 持续感染；持续性感染
短语：persistent vegetative state — 持续性植物状态；植物状态
短语：persistent pollutant — 持久性污染物
例句：persistent rumours
持续流传的谣言
例句：persistent headaches
持续头疼
例句：a persistent problem
长期问题
例句：persistent rain
连绵的雨

surpass
音标：英 /səˈpɑ:s/  美 /sə'pæs/
v. 超过
短语：surpass the advanced — 赶超先进
例句：He had surpassed all our expectations .
他超越了我们所有的预期。
例句：The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

dilemma
音标：英 /dɪˈlemə/  美 /dɪˈlemə/
n. 困境
短语：in a dilemma — 进退两难，左右为难
短语：prisoner's dilemma — 囚徒困境，囚徒困境悖论
短语：moral dilemma — 道德上的左右为难；道德两难处境；伦理两难
短语：ethical dilemma — 道德困境；伦理困境
例句：a moral dilemma
道德上进退两难的窘境
例句：This placed Robert Kennedy in a dilemma.
这让罗伯特·肯尼迪陷入了两难的境地。
例句：Many women are faced with the dilemma of choosing between work and family commitments.
许多女性面临着出去工作还是照顾家庭的两难境地。

generate
音标：英 /ˈdʒenəreɪt/  美 /'dʒɛnəret/
v. 产生
短语：generate electricity — 发电
短语：generate profit — 创利，产生利润
例句：a useful technique for generating new ideas
能产生新创意的有用技术
例句：The program would generate a lot of new jobs.
这个项目将创造许多新的就业岗位。

primary
音标：英 /ˈpraɪməri/  美 /'praɪmɛri/
adj. 主要的，基本的
短语：primary school — 小学
短语：primary stage — 初始阶段
短语：primary purpose — 主要目的；根本目的
短语：primary factor — 主因子，准素因子；一次因素
短语：primary education — 初等教育
短语：primary goal — 首要目标
短语：primary function — 主功能；基函数
短语：primary energy — 一次能源；最初的电子能量
短语：primary air — 一次空气
短语：primary source — 主源；第一手来源
短语：primary focus — 主焦点；优先考虑
短语：primary care — 初级治疗，初级护理；基层医疗
短语：primary concern — 主要关心的事
短语：primary data — 原始数据；原始资料
短语：primary treatment — 一次处理；初级处理
短语：primary production — 初级生产
短语：primary key — 主关键字，主键标
短语：primary health care — 初级保健护理
短语：primary culture — 原始培养；初代培养
短语：primary market — 初级市场；初次市场（即证券发行机构）
例句：Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。
例句：Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。
例句：Personal safety is of primary importance .
人身安全至关重要。

vitally
音标：英 /ˈvaɪtəli/  美 /'vaɪtəli/
adv. 极其重要地
短语：vitally important — 极其重要的
例句：A sensible diet is vitally important if you want to remain in good health.
如想保持健康，合理的饮食十分重要。
